facts.fact: Colm 在暴风雪来临前的清晨早早到达。
facts.anchor: Colm arrives early in the morning just before the blizzard bears down.

facts.fact: 她让 Colm 把车停在小屋一英里外的一条旧伐木路上（不显眼处），再用 4Runner 把他接回来。
facts.anchor: she has him park there out of sight and picks him up in the 4Runner

facts.fact: Colm 查了 Leah，说她这个周末去弗吉尼亚拜访朋友了，还发了照片上网。
facts.anchor: I checked on Leah and she’s visiting friends down in Virginia this weekend

facts.fact: Tommy 说 Leah 出门多半就是他今天选择来的原因。
facts.anchor: Probably why he chose to come today

facts.fact: Colm 说这场雪会让他们慢一点，并说要是知道他什么时候到就好了。
facts.anchor: This will slow him down a little

facts.fact: Hattie 从牛仔裤口袋里拿出 Ed 的左轮手枪放在桌上。
facts.anchor: Hattie takes Ed’s revolver from her jeans pocket and lays it on the table.

facts.fact: 打给 Dustin 的电话之后他们一直把手枪放在手边，Hattie 已经厌倦了带着它。
